notes.title: New small patch with few improvements and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Greetings, Cleaners!

We’ve been working lately on polishing up your cleaning experience, and we’re excited to share the latest improvements in this patch! Your feedback has been very valuable, and we’ve addressed several key issues to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable journey across all maps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/6615b5661242b292c6e2a54a07419d754db93e73.png

Localization Fixes:
Fixed mismatched fonts in some localizations for a consistent and polished in-game text experience.

Completion Enhancements:
Improved the ability to achieve 100% completion on all maps—no more sneaky spots!

UI Adjustments:
Fixed buttons being obscured during cutscenes, ensuring full accessibility.

Map Improvements:
Fixed the bridge on the Forest map for better navigation.
Adjusted animal positions on the Forest map for a more natural and engaging environment.
Corrected the placement of misplaced trash piles across maps.

Audio Upgrades:
Enhanced cat sound effects to make your furry companions more lifelike.

Building Enhancements:
Improved the appearance of tents during structure building for a more satisfying visual experience.

Material Fixes:
Fixed material issues in the Asian-themed scene for a more cohesive look.

Scanner Update:
Fixed scanner functionality on the African map to help you clean up with precision.

Plant Preservation:
Addressed disappearing plants to keep your green spaces thriving.

Loading Bar Visibility:
Improved the visibility of loading bars for better progress tracking.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/d2feadb5dbad98c43071768aac2c154fc2a255cf.png

Thank you for your continued support and feedback—it’s what helps us make Fresh Start Cleaning Simulator even better!

Happy cleaning!
The Fresh Start Team 🌱

notes.title: Fresh Start splashes out of early access! The full release is here!
notes.notes:
Hey, cleaners!

Today’s the day! The day we all grab our cleaning tools, suck the dirt up and sprinkle life back into the planet!

Fresh Start’s full release is OUT NOW!

The road to releasing the game was one filled with fun, joy and excitement. There were also challenges and hardships to overcome, but we managed, and in no small part thanks to your continuous support and feedback. The game’s better thanks to you, and for that we’re really grateful!

With the full release comes new content, and there’s lots of it! We teased it in the previous updates to keep you up to speed, but this is the time we’d like to show you (almost) everything that’s new in the game.

No more stalling - here’s what’s new in the full release of Fresh Start! Enjoy!

Doubled content - 2x more maps!
Not one, not two, but five! There are 5 brand new maps for you to discover, along with lots of new creatures to meet and help! That’s a lot of dirt-cleaning and water-spraying, but let’s be honest - that’s nothing you can’t deal with. Have fun cleaning them up and bringing them back to their clean and colorful selves!

Look at those sad faces - they need your help to be happy again.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/5f633b1b93bf810f67ccc35424bf184f39246501.jpg

Alps
A lovely mountainside is in need of some help. Bee there or be square!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/03b270b319732f38d8a04dbcfba5fd08d8d18f39.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/ae4175fd5b19891b02b825952b4704f73cc57d8a.png

Forest
Destroyed bird houses and wild animal feeders is something we can’t ignore. And the animal traps need to go, too.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/66f577b66896015f94b10dc9232f3f4a947265d1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/f7110649518efa4f8ae559122b9da63ee535bbb4.png

Onsen
Onsen are a place of rejuvenation. It needs some deep cleaning so that the inner and outer peace can be found and restored.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/a0361a306ad5983bfb6cfe146dc5943ea4b900d4.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/58c567d4462f68ee159b5261b883b9495bb465a2.png

Garden
It’s not just a community garden, it’s a place that allows you to reconnect with nature.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/254dbfb9b4e445e84f77cea657afebf4d6b8dcc6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/f44716beaaac3a45f9a7f42bce2548e2aa94361c.png

Poland
This will be the end of your journey (unless you want to revisit previous maps) - clean up the countryside vacation spot and set up everything for a deserved rest. A surprise is waiting for you here - don’t miss it! :)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/e295601366a8aa5f561769a6e31685c838f03682.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/831f5cb6acb5e6395640520c2172fe09f4cf18a2.png

Plenty of new quests
New maps mean new quests. As in the early access maps, these provide additional tasks you have to fulfill while cleaning up the environment. Each map has its own quests and each completed one nets you experience and brings you closer to fully reviving the nature. We don’t want to spoil too much here, though - we want you to find and experience the quests yourself. Happy questing!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/309c12e6196bf6e8dfbb292c60bb5dc8603ff791.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/3598f2c161d648da7213cf4929d258f3c47f775c.jpg

3 new skills
Someone watered the skill trees! Well, that’s convenient, isn’t it? Each skill tree now has its top skill available for you to unlock and use! With these, the fun of restoring the world will grow like the flowers you’ll be watering throughout your journey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/7de3dee43dfe35ec52ec0fcecbadf05b9c36e065.png

Water Flash - will give you power to destroy mud and water plants instantly
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/14d972ff7efc4e90fe3a41f6c8480d6f35932c0f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/4f99311df451ecf851da59d2535bcb2e160acafd.jpg

Cyclone - turns trash collecting into a superpower
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/28763289ff3bedcf4ac542cd6c733af96318dbed.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/5c2e8970c8c8d0a6cc613fcfeb4547e5c3104b03.jpg

Robot Friend - forget about going back and looking for your robots - now, they’ll always be at your disposal

New animals to save and befriend
Every map has new animals that need your attention… or at least a cuddle. Find them and help them out - they’re crucial to the well-being of the planet! They’re adorable, too, so be careful not to get swept away by their cuteness.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/a881baf2f013a53fc6327eb9cc0681413f77f681.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/c71c68c0edc2085ccead308c757ac41355f8213c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/b342691dff6c0348aee52485255923bd8563ee4d.png

Upgraded UI
The UI is now upgraded and updated to be more readable, clear and overall better. You can check out the comparison below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/43f9bab1792e889ccbb5aa9e93928d9036f79fd0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/49d53bb65e99100f1105ff683516aa9d25123988.jpg

The way that quests show you what’s needed has changed too - now a bigger icon is shown on your screen instead of a small one in a white pop up above the interactive item.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/927d1d23de20cbfd980a2925a10efa6ec7171433.jpg

Achievements
We’ve got something for the achievement hunters, too! If you’re one of those players that like some additional challenge in the games in the form of getting achievements, there are 24 of those waiting for you to grab. Also, additional 6 are hidden and you’ll have to find them by yourself. 



Full Controller support
The game now fully supports controllers, so you can grab the one that’s your favorite and play the way you prefer it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/0a73fb9894f50a748530838464c902e95b77ba5a.png

9 languages to choose from
The game now supports new languages! Overall, there are now 9 language options to choose from. These are: English, Polish, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese & Traditional Chinese.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/9ee428dd0b6977aff2f835e25da3115ba03b1e6a.png

Whew, that’s it. We sincerely hope you’re satisfied with the amount of new stuff in the game and that you’ll have fun playing and discovering all the new content. We put our hearts into the game to make it a fun, relaxing and satisfying experience. If we managed to do that, please remember leaving a review helps us a lot and gives us an extra boost. 

Hopefully, this little world-cleaning journey around the globe will be something you enjoy. Maybe it will even put a smile on your face. If it does, that means we’ve achieved our goal :)

Have fun reviving the nature!
Chicken Launcher Team


As always, if you have any questions or concerns, please let us know. We’ll be more happy to help. Drop us an email at contact.nplh@awakenrealms.com, join our discord https://discord.gg/ryJmMJqk, and of course you’re welcome to join the Discussions here on Steam: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1856030/discussions/

notes.title: FULL RELEASE of Fresh Start will arrive on December 20th!
notes.notes:
Hey, cleaners!

We were very busy with working on adding more content and polishing the game and now… the Full Release is just around the corner!

We have carefully gathered your feedback to make the game better and we’re also super grateful for all the kind words from all of you. It’s truly heartwarming to know that the game can bring so much joy and tranquility at the same time, making it possible to unwind, relax and have some fun - it really feels like what we do matters and makes you feel better :)

Let’s jump right into the update proper. First, to have an idea of what’s coming, let’s take a look at the world map:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/7e5b73d884fbeaed9748099acc5032556c57424a.png

As you can probably tell by looking at the animal icons, we’ll be adding FIVE BRAND NEW MAPS! Each one is different, but all of them need your help cleaning them up and bringing them back to life - there’s mud and trash (and plants in dire need of watering) everywhere!

Here’s a little sneak peak of what you can expect (we don’t want to spoil all of the surprises):

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/c191a37ec3459aba6112b5acfde095534fe32caf.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/67b09528cb2d43ca9c78920089153005a8d10329.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/b65f2a29199bacbf64adb80eae2e5626c24667ff.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/c5e97a7db5cce6dd41cf7b061b33040c2bf2a62b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/1bc067e24ca519067ea64bd0cf3a442ffa7a5b27.png

Apart from what we promised - New Languages (including traditional Chinese), Full Controller Support and Achievements - here’s what’s coming in the full release:
- New Skills (top of the tree skills)
- Steam Community Items
- Extra layer of polish to new and already existing maps (new map details, 2d art and more!)

We hope you’re as excited for the launch as we are. That’s it for today’s update, but there’s still a lot of places that we want to improve upon even more, so it’s back to work for us. Thank you for all your continued support and involvement!

Stay fresh!

The Chicken Launcher Team
